notes.seasonalWhy: Migrations, calving and dry-season waterhole viewing, but many places have wildlife all year
notes.reviewTrigger: A park closes or bans an activity
notes.stakesWhy: Dangerous-animal advice and park rules matter, but most trips are low risk; a wrong guess mostly wastes a day.
notes.refreshWhy: Gemini-written overviews and 12 monthly blurbs for 200 places, with every risky claim fact-checked (333 checked claims). A refresh means regenerating and re-checking.

notes.seasonalWhy: Migration and breeding peaks
notes.staleFirst: Species names (eBird renames each autumn) and hotspot access
notes.reviewTrigger: The yearly eBird taxonomy update
notes.stakesWhy: A wrong hotspot or season wastes a trip but rarely harms anyone; the one rule column is "Guide needed?".
notes.refreshWhy: 200 places with bird lists and a name pass against eBird. A refresh means regenerating text and re-checking about 1,100 claims.

notes.seasonalWhy: Dry season concentrates game, wet season closes roads, migrations have dates
notes.staleFirst: Park fees, concession and camp changes, road closures
notes.reviewTrigger: New fee rules or a lodge closing
notes.stakesWhy: Dangerous wildlife, park fees and lodge bookings: a wrong park or season costs thousands, and big-game advice is a safety matter.
notes.refreshWhy: 17 places with Gemini text and fact-check plus a hand-built great-herds evidence file.

notes.seasonalWhy: Each species is present only some months
notes.staleFirst: Operators, vessel rules, shifting season dates
notes.reviewTrigger: New whale-watching regulations
notes.stakesWhy: Seasickness and operator rules; a wrong season wastes an expensive trip but is safe.
notes.refreshWhy: 123 places with Gemini text, a source check against whale-watching sites, and stored N/A reasons.

notes.seasonalWhy: Snow, foliage and haze change views; many places stay scenic all year
notes.staleFirst: Viewpoint and road access (closures belong to advisories)
notes.reviewTrigger: A landmark collapses or is closed for good
notes.stakesWhy: A wrong view or a closed road wastes a day; low harm.
notes.refreshWhy: 200 places of judged 0 to 10 ratings with named anchors; each needs re-judging by a person.

notes.seasonalWhy: Snow, fire season and weather decide whether camping is possible
notes.staleFirst: Permit and reservation systems, fire bans, campground closures
notes.reviewTrigger: A new permit lottery
notes.stakesWhy: Carries the Wild camping law and Dangerous wildlife columns: a wrong law means a fine or being moved on, and wrong bear or big-game advice is a safety risk.
notes.refreshWhy: Counts re-pull by script (OpenStreetMap, Overture). Wild-camping law and dangerous wildlife were researched by hand for 75 and 23 places.

notes.seasonalWhy: Milky Way season and clear-sky months, though dark nights exist all year
notes.staleFirst: Light pollution creep and dark-sky designations
notes.reviewTrigger: A new dark-sky reserve
notes.stakesWhy: A cloudy or bright night is the worst outcome.
notes.refreshWhy: Dark-sky certification and darkness class can be looked up; clear-sky and photography ratings are judged for 200 places.

notes.seasonalWhy: Needs long dark nights, so only a few months at each place
notes.staleFirst: Solar cycle outlook, tour operators, light pollution
notes.reviewTrigger: Solar maximum announcements
notes.stakesWhy: Tours are expensive and the window is short, so a wrong season or place wastes a once-in-a-trip chance; no safety risk beyond cold.
notes.refreshWhy: 22 places with seeded facts and judged strength; the solar-cycle outlook is re-assessed by hand.

notes.seasonalWhy: Snow closes roads and trails; eruptions are not seasonal
notes.staleFirst: Volcano activity and access (alerts belong to advisories)
notes.reviewTrigger: An eruption that changes a landscape
notes.stakesWhy: Active volcanoes, geothermal areas and caves can hurt people. Alerts belong to advisories, but wrong access advice still matters.
notes.refreshWhy: Wikidata, OpenStreetMap and Overture scripts rebuild all eight parts; only the UNESCO and geopark lists need a yearly look.

notes.seasonalWhy: A bloom or colour peak lasts weeks
notes.staleFirst: Peak timing, which drifts with climate
notes.reviewTrigger: An unusual bloom year
notes.stakesWhy: Missing a bloom wastes a trip but harms no one.
notes.refreshWhy: 58 places with bloom and colour ratings from sources by hand plus Gemini text.

notes.seasonalWhy: Snow-free windows, hut opening dates, heat and monsoon
notes.staleFirst: Trail closures, hut and permit rules
notes.reviewTrigger: A permit system starts
notes.stakesWhy: Altitude, booking-ahead and permit columns: a wrong permit rule can mean being turned away, and a wrong difficulty can injure.
notes.refreshWhy: 200 places, 16 columns and the biggest fact-check load (2,433 claims); permits and trail rules are by hand.

notes.seasonalWhy: Climbing seasons are short and weather-windowed
notes.staleFirst: Permit regimes and fees, route changes, glacier retreat
notes.reviewTrigger: New fees or a closed peak
notes.stakesWhy: Climbing levels, guide rules, permits and planning-ahead: bad advice can cost a life or an expedition fee.
notes.refreshWhy: 73 places with routes, permits and levels researched by hand.

notes.seasonalWhy: Heat, snow and wind; mountain passes close
notes.reviewTrigger: A major route is closed or reopened
notes.stakesWhy: Ride levels and road safety; moderate.
notes.refreshWhy: 196 places with judged ratings and iconic climbs counted by hand.

notes.seasonalWhy: Snow cover, and bike-park lifts run for one summer season
notes.reviewTrigger: A bike park opens or closes
notes.stakesWhy: Trail grades and lift access; a wrong grade can mean injury.
notes.refreshWhy: OpenStreetMap trails, lifts and rentals rebuild by script; lift-served parks were checked by hand for 8 places.

notes.seasonalWhy: No snow, no skiing
notes.staleFirst: Resort ownership, lifts and pass networks change every season
notes.reviewTrigger: A resort closes or merges
notes.stakesWhy: Resorts, passes and snow reliability are expensive, and terrain level and avalanche conditions matter.
notes.refreshWhy: 60 places with ski-area facts and judged ratings, partly from resort lists.

notes.seasonalWhy: Swell seasons and winds
notes.staleFirst: Breaks are stable; schools and access change slowly
notes.reviewTrigger: A break is closed or built over
notes.stakesWhy: Main hazards and permits-or-limits columns: wrong break level or hazard advice can injure.
notes.refreshWhy: 102 places. Wave records are scripted, but breaks, hazards and permits are hand-researched, with Gemini text and a source check.

notes.seasonalWhy: Visibility, water temperature and marine-life seasons; many places dive all year
notes.reviewTrigger: A marine park changes its rules
notes.stakesWhy: Certification needed and Current columns: wrong depth, current or certification advice is a safety issue.
notes.refreshWhy: 114 places of Gemini text, wreck and animal evidence, and source checks.

notes.seasonalWhy: Wind seasons
notes.reviewTrigger: A spot is banned or restricted
notes.stakesWhy: Levels served and rules and restrictions: a wrong level or a banned spot.
notes.refreshWhy: 41 places. Wind records re-pull by script; spots, rules and schools are by hand.

notes.seasonalWhy: Wind and storm seasons
notes.reviewTrigger: A charter company leaves a base
notes.stakesWhy: Charter licence rules and sea conditions; moderate to high.
notes.refreshWhy: OpenStreetMap marinas re-pull by script; regattas and expedition operators were researched by hand, bareboat bases read from two charter sites.

notes.seasonalWhy: Snowmelt and rainfall set river flows
notes.reviewTrigger: A river permit changes
notes.stakesWhy: Whitewater classes, skill levels served and guide requirements: a wrong class puts beginners in dangerous water.
notes.refreshWhy: Map counts rebuild by script; whitewater rivers, classes and multi-day trips were searched by hand for 67 places.

notes.seasonalWhy: Weather limits most activities
notes.staleFirst: Operators and safety rules (an accident can change rules fast)
notes.reviewTrigger: A ban after an accident
notes.stakesWhy: Effort levels and private trips: operators and safety rules for bungee, paragliding and the like.
notes.refreshWhy: 200 places of judged ratings across seven columns.

notes.seasonalWhy: Closed or unplayable through winter in much of the world
notes.reviewTrigger: A famous course closes or opens to visitors
notes.stakesWhy: A wrong tee-time rule wastes an afternoon; no risk.
notes.refreshWhy: Courses, links, scenic and bucket-list venues rebuild by script; only tee-time rules (6 places) are by hand.

notes.seasonalWhy: Runs and open seasons
notes.staleFirst: Permits, catch-and-release and guide rules, closed seasons
notes.reviewTrigger: A rule change in a major fishery
notes.stakesWhy: Catch-and-release and guide rules: a wrong rule means fines or a banned fishery, while the fishing itself is low risk.
notes.refreshWhy: GBIF species and Overture businesses rebuild by script; catch-and-release and guide rules were researched by hand for 26 and 10 places.

notes.seasonalWhy: Weather and ground conditions
notes.reviewTrigger: A major ranch or outfitter closes
notes.stakesWhy: Rider levels served; a mismatch can injure.
notes.refreshWhy: 34 places with hand evidence files for operators and horse culture.

notes.seasonalWhy: Snow-free windows and heat
notes.staleFirst: Race dates, which are set a year ahead
notes.reviewTrigger: A famous race is cancelled
notes.stakesWhy: Remote terrain and relief; a wrong difficulty can strand someone.
notes.refreshWhy: OpenStreetMap trails and huts plus elevation rebuild by script; race lists come from Wikipedia.

notes.seasonalWhy: Mostly open all year; some sites close or flood seasonally
notes.staleFirst: Closures for restoration, new excavations opening
notes.reviewTrigger: A site closes or reopens
notes.stakesWhy: Closed or changed sites waste a visit; low harm.
notes.refreshWhy: 89 places of judged ratings; UNESCO lists help, but each place is assessed by hand.

notes.seasonalWhy: Indoors; the exceptions are places whose museums close for winter
notes.reviewTrigger: A flagship museum closes for years
notes.stakesWhy: A closed museum wastes an hour.
notes.refreshWhy: 168 places by 9 judged columns, including museum hours and days.

notes.seasonalWhy: Buildings do not change with the seasons
notes.reviewTrigger: A landmark opens or is lost
notes.stakesWhy: A lost landmark wastes a detour.
notes.refreshWhy: 165 places by 7 judged columns.

notes.seasonalWhy: Weather matters, the scene does not close
notes.reviewTrigger: A major event or policy changes a city
notes.stakesWhy: Neighbourhood advice that is out of date wastes time, with some safety overlap.
notes.refreshWhy: 119 places of judged ratings.

notes.seasonalWhy: Ceremony and harvest calendars; some communities host seasonally
notes.reviewTrigger: A community changes who may visit
notes.stakesWhy: Visiting a community without consent, or paying a non-community operator, causes cultural harm and sends money to the wrong people. The Indigenous-led tick must be right.
notes.refreshWhy: 61 places researched by hand; each community-led claim needs its own source.

notes.seasonalWhy: Festivals and pilgrimage seasons
notes.staleFirst: Access and dress rules, restoration closures
notes.reviewTrigger: A site restricts visitors
notes.stakesWhy: Site rules such as dress, behaviour and access: wrong advice can offend or mean being refused entry.
notes.refreshWhy: 88 places judged, with site rules researched by hand.

notes.seasonalWhy: Events are dated
notes.reviewTrigger: A festival is cancelled or moved
notes.stakesWhy: Dates drive whole trips: a wrong date wastes flights and hotels.
notes.refreshWhy: 176 places where dates, headliners and booking-ahead change every year and are checked by hand.

notes.seasonalWhy: Workshops mostly run all year
notes.reviewTrigger: A craft village closes to visitors
notes.stakesWhy: A closed workshop wastes a trip to a village.
notes.refreshWhy: 40 places researched by hand.

notes.seasonalWhy: Markets run all year
notes.reviewTrigger: A market is moved or closed
notes.stakesWhy: Carries an Illness risk column: a wrong call can make someone ill.
notes.refreshWhy: 198 places by 9 columns; vendors and markets change, so it is by hand.

notes.seasonalWhy: Exceptions are resort towns where restaurants close for a season
notes.staleFirst: Restaurants opening and closing; the star lists change every year
notes.reviewTrigger: A new guide edition
notes.stakesWhy: Booking-ahead and price advice: a wrong answer loses a table or blows a budget; no safety risk.
notes.refreshWhy: 199 places. Michelin counts are re-read from the guide; the other columns are judged, and price and booking are by hand.

notes.seasonalWhy: Harvest and tasting seasons
notes.staleFirst: Producers opening and closing, tasting-room rules
notes.reviewTrigger: A famous producer closes to visitors
notes.stakesWhy: A wrong producer or opening hours wastes an afternoon.
notes.refreshWhy: Overture and Wikidata rebuild the five ratings; celebrated wines and spirits were read from Wikipedia for 12 to 26 places.

notes.seasonalWhy: Cafés run all year
notes.reviewTrigger: A scene shifts neighbourhood
notes.stakesWhy: A closed café wastes ten minutes.
notes.refreshWhy: 117 places judged.

notes.seasonalWhy: Sea temperature and weather decide the swimming months
notes.staleFirst: Water quality, erosion and jellyfish or sargassum years
notes.reviewTrigger: A beach is closed or lost
notes.stakesWhy: Swim-hazard months, water clarity and calm-water columns: wrong calm-water advice can put swimmers at risk from rips and jellyfish.
notes.refreshWhy: 125 places by 13 columns of judged ratings and hazard months, with Gemini text for 105.

notes.seasonalWhy: Sun and warmth
notes.reviewTrigger: A beach is closed
notes.stakesWhy: Sun exposure is the only risk.
notes.refreshWhy: 199 places, six columns, judgement plus climate numbers.

notes.seasonalWhy: Rates move with season; few hotels shut, apart from seasonal lodges
notes.staleFirst: Hotels opening, closing and changing brand
notes.reviewTrigger: A major hotel opens or closes
notes.stakesWhy: High-ticket bookings: a wrong hotel claim costs thousands; no safety risk.
notes.refreshWhy: 200 places; hotels open and close, and there is no free list to re-pull.

notes.seasonalWhy: Resorts mostly run all year
notes.staleFirst: Resorts opening, closing and changing brand
notes.reviewTrigger: A brand exits a destination
notes.stakesWhy: Large prepaid packages: wrong inclusions cost real money.
notes.refreshWhy: 24 places. Resort counts were from memory, and the judged columns need the chains' own pages.

notes.seasonalWhy: Indoors and mostly all year
notes.reviewTrigger: A flagship spa closes
notes.stakesWhy: A closed spa wastes a booking.
notes.refreshWhy: 199 places judged.

notes.seasonalWhy: Best in cold months, open all year
notes.reviewTrigger: A facility closes or a spring changes
notes.stakesWhy: Some springs are scalding or closed, and fees vary; moderate.
notes.refreshWhy: 27 places with seeded facts and 11 columns, Gemini text for 27.

notes.seasonalWhy: Retreat calendars cluster in some months
notes.reviewTrigger: A major centre closes
notes.stakesWhy: Deposits and week-long commitments, and a practice-level mismatch.
notes.refreshWhy: 20 places researched by hand from retreat directories.

notes.seasonalWhy: Seasonal operation and weather
notes.reviewTrigger: A park opens or closes
notes.stakesWhy: Ticket prices and ride closures; low safety.
notes.refreshWhy: 20 places whose ratings come from stated formulas on RCDB, the TEA water-park list and Wikidata zoo visitors.

notes.seasonalWhy: Resort-town exceptions
notes.reviewTrigger: A scene collapses or opens up
notes.stakesWhy: District safety and scams; moderate.
notes.refreshWhy: 172 places judged.

notes.seasonalWhy: Markets and malls run all year; sales seasons are a small swing
notes.reviewTrigger: A tax-refund rule change
notes.stakesWhy: A closed shop or tax rule costs a little money.
notes.refreshWhy: 189 places judged.
